subject: SeedSpark Accelerator — promotional credit grant verification
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@seedspark.vc>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bulk promotional credit request for upcoming cohort

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — SeedSpark is kicking off our Spring cohort (25 companies) and we want to offer Redwood credits as part of the program benefits. Historically we give each company a credit bundle that covers initial experimentation and a short pilot.

Can Redwood provide a promo/grant for the cohort? We're targeting ~50k credits per company to ensure teams can run meaningful evals and prototypes during the 12-week program. We'll sign an MOA if required.

What information do you need to confirm eligibility? I can share the cohort roster, MOA, and any other evidence required. We're on a tight timeline — cohort starts 2026-02-22.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Program Director | SeedSpark Accelerator
elena@seedspark.vc
attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@seedspark.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bulk promotional credit request for upcoming cohort

Hi Elena — great to hear and congrats on the cohort kickoff.

Quick summary of how we handle these: for PLG signups we have a self-serve grant flow (smaller bundles), but for accelerator/VC bulk grants we require a verification step plus approval from the grants team for amounts >20k/company. Typical evidence we need:
- Completed MOA signed by the accelerator
- Cohort roster (company name, point of contact, email)
- Short note on expected usage profile (R&D vs production evals)

If you can send the roster + signed MOA I will start the internal approval. Also let me know if you prefer promo codes (per-company) or direct top-ups to new accounts — we can do either, but codes are faster.

If helpful, I can loop in Marissa (cc'd) to expedite; she handles larger program grants and any exceptions.

Next step from our side: I'll prepare a request packet with finance/legal checklist and target an approval decision within 48–72 hours once we have the attached evidence.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Growth | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Request: approval to issue accelerator bulk grant — SeedSpark Spring cohort

Team — forwarding request from SeedSpark. Key details:
- Account: SeedSpark Accelerator (external)
- Cohort size: 25 companies
- Requested amount: 50,000 credits per company (requesting 1.25M total)
- Evidence provided: signed MOA (seedspark_moa.pdf), cohort roster (accelerator_roster.csv)
- Preferred delivery: per-company promo code (faster)
- Timeline: cohort starts 2026-02-22; they need codes distributed by 2026-02-18

Policy note: our standard accelerator bundle is 20k/company for pre-approved partners; anything above requires grants team approval and finance sign-off for accounting/tax considerations. I'm asking for an exception to approve 40k–50k per company for this cohort.

Options to consider:
1) Approve full request: issue 25 promo codes x 50k credits (1.25M credits total). Finance to create revenue/expense tags.
2) Approve a reduced amount: 25 x 40k credits (1.0M credits) as a middle ground.
3) Offer mixed approach: 20k self-serve + 30k contingent on onboarding and follow-up evaluation (release top-up after 4 weeks).

Please review the attached MOA and roster (attached below). I'm happy to draft the communication template and promo codes if we get sign-off.

Attachments: seedspark_moa.pdf, accelerator_roster.csv, credit_policy_excerpt.pdf

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: approval to issue accelerator bulk grant — SeedSpark Spring cohort

Ben — reviewed the packet. Approve with conditions:

1) Approve option (2): 25 x 40k credits (total 1.0M credits). This balances program support with our unit economics.
2) Require MOA countersigned by our Partnerships lead (please route to legal for final signature).
3) Promo delivery: issue per-company single-use promo codes that expire 90 days after issuance. Do not auto-top-up accounts.
4) Require a light evaluation checkpoint at week 4: account owner to report basic usage metrics (tokens consumed, number of API calls, top repo names).
5) Finance: Laura, please confirm we can book this as Marketing/Partner credit and advise any invoicing or 1099 requirements if applicable.

Once legal confirms countersignature, Ben you can proceed to generate the codes and provide the distribution template. If SeedSpark needs earlier access for a subset of founders, we can consider 10 early codes (40k each) to distribute on 2026-02-16.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bulk promotional credit request for upcoming cohort — approved (conditional)

Hi Elena — good news: we've approved a program grant for SeedSpark's Spring cohort with conditions. Summary:
- Approved: 25 single-use promo codes at 40,000 credits each (total 1,000,000 credits).
- Next steps: we need countersigned MOA from Redwood legal; please confirm that the attached MOA is signed on your side and we'll route ours for countersignature.
- Delivery: once countersigned, we'll generate single-use promo codes that expire 90 days after issuance. We can provide up to 10 early codes (40k each) on 2026-02-16 if you need to distribute to founders before full issuance on 2026-02-18.
- Evaluation: we'll request a brief usage checkpoint at week 4 (simple CSV or HubSpot update).
- Finance: Laura (cc) will follow up on the accounting tag and any tax/invoice notes.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions and attach the MOA copy to this thread; once legal signs we'll proceed.

Thanks and excited to support the cohort — please pass this along to the founders as appropriate.

Best,
